lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and eight vertical columns are visible in the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region. The spots exhibit a higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter anteriorly, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids towards the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like matrix. These intersections are most prominent in the region directly posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank. It is characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with light reflecting off the dorsal aspect of the ridge and a narrow band of shadow immediately ventral to it.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-15 identifiable high-luminance spots. These spots appear more concentrated towards the lower half and the leading edge of the fin, with a lower density observed near the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct ectoparasites or commensal organisms (remoras) are visible: one is positioned horizontally along the upper mid-flank, and a second is positioned near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
